title: Biological weapons were dangerous before AI entered the lab
teaser: A recent Anthropic report described five researchers from other countries trying to get Claude to help with gain-of-function research. The company refused and blocked their accounts, while acknowledging that their motives might not have been malicious. That episode has sharpened fears about AI and biological weapons. But journalist Michael Mechanic’s interview with author Annie Jacobsen points to a harder truth: the danger does not depend on chatbots. Researchers, states and academic institutions already work with pathogens that could cause a pandemic, and accidental release may be more likely than a deliberate attack.
